name: L-carnitine
class: Quaternary amine fatty acid transporter cofactor

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A quaternary amine required to shuttle long-chain fatty acids into the mitochondrion. Prescription levocarnitine is separately approved for primary and secondary carnitine deficiency. Oral supplementation raises gut-derived TMAO, whose cardiovascular significance is contested.

systems.note: Fatty acid transport into the mitochondrion; the intended effect.
Gut microbial conversion to TMAO raises a contested cardiovascular concern.

monitors.why: The accessible inflammatory index relevant to the contested TMAO pathway.
Fatty acid handling is the pathway involved.
